analysis.analysis: General Marxian accounting framework presented first: 'applies the Labor Theory of Value to financial ledgers, interpreting standard capitalist accounting as a tool that measures and enforces the extraction of surplus value.' Then the 'Semantic Dimension': 'the Marxian accounting framework has evolved to analyze immaterial and digital economies. In this semantic economy, meaning itself (language, attention, and data) is tracked through a closed-loop accounting cycle.' Semantic Labor, Semantic Capital, Semantic Rent enumerated. Investopedia 'Marxian Economics' image used. Zenodo SE and Academia Marxian Accounting in organic. AI Overview bridges general Marxian economics into the archive's framework.
